LanguageData.RavenTrap_Lego.label: [Raven] Lego Landmine
LanguageData.RavenTrap_Lego.description: Colorful plastic bricks scattered on the ground. They look harmless, but stepping on them barefoot causes unimaginable pain... Ouch.
LanguageData.RavenTrap_Conception.label: [Raven] Spirit Egg Implantation Trap
LanguageData.RavenTrap_Conception.description: A special trap used for reproductive management. When triggered, it restrains the target and forcefully implants a Raven Spirit Egg into their body.
